reuse.why: Adds the check inside the existing linkBankSyncAccount that every provider-specific link function already funnels through, reusing its existing account lookup.

duplication.why: Moves the existing upgradingId lookup earlier and reuses the fetched row, so no query or check is duplicated.

placement.why: The closed-account guard sits in the shared server-side link function next to the existing already-linked guard, before any side effect.

scope.why: Only the guard, the relocated lookup and focused tests are changed.

maintainability.why: One validation block at the top of the shared link path, easy to read and extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses linkBankSyncAccount, the shared path for all providers.

disguised_duplication.where: The account lookup is moved, not copied.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount, called by every provider link function (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, etc.).
